joined.title: The refresh stall aging your fleet
joined.subtitle: Device refresh (Ariba) x patch compliance (ServiceNow) x hardware tickets (Jira) - indexed, Sep = 100

insight.headline: Zero laptops refreshed since March — hardware tickets up 82% while patch compliance stalls under 95%
insight.detail: Joining Ariba deliveries to ServiceNow compliance and Jira tickets shows wave 3 froze at 312 of 690 devices in March — the month hardware tickets started climbing from 39 to 71 and patch compliance flatlined in the 94s until August's forced restarts. Ariba only sees a pending $142,800 Dell PO, ServiceNow only sees a compliance plateau, and Jira only sees ticket creep — none alone shows the aging un-refreshed fleet driving both.
insight.action: Approve PO-58217 today and front-load the 72-unit Austin shipment at the 13:00 Dell check-in
